div.head: Swer 6
div.ab: His geferan að, þe him mid standað. On ðone Drihten, se að is clæne 7 unmæne, ðe N. swor.
In ipso Deo, iusiurandum est clene et unmene, quod N. iurauit.
On ðone Drihten, se að is clæne 7 unmæne, ðe N. swor.
[I swear] by the Lord [that] the oath sworn by N. is honest and without perjury.
(Eid seines Genossen, der bei ihm [als Eideshelfer] steht. B) Bei dem Herrn …, der Eid ist rein und ohne Falsch, den N. [der Hauptschwörer] geschworen hat.
(The oath of his companion who stands with him [as oath-helper]. B) By the Lord …, the oath is clean and without falsehood which N. [the principal swearer] has sworn.
